title: Jack-o'-lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pumpkin body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='34' ry='28' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <!-- pumpkin ribs -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='20' ry='28' fill='#ffa740'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='7' ry='28' fill='#ffbe66'/>
  <!-- top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='45' rx='12' ry='6' fill='#ffd08a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='45' y='28' width='10' height='10' rx='3' fill='#4a8a2a'/>
  <rect x='47' y='27' width='5' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6ab840'/>
  <!-- carved eyes: triangles, glowing yellow -->
  <polygon points='32,52 44,52 38,64' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <polygon points='56,52 68,52 62,64' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <!-- eye inner glow -->
  <polygon points='35,54 41,54 38,60' fill='#fff7b0'/>
  <polygon points='59,54 65,54 62,60' fill='#fff7b0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points='47,65 53,65 50,71' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <!-- carved mouth -->
  <path d='M32,74 L38,74 L41,70 L44,74 L47,70 L50,74 L53,70 L56,74 L59,70 L62,74 L68,74 Q68,82 50,82 Q32,82 32,74 Z' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <!-- mouth inner glow -->
  <path d='M36,76 L40,76 L42,73 L44,76 L47,73 L50,76 L53,73 L56,76 L58,73 L60,76 L64,76 Q64,79 50,79 Q36,79 36,76 Z' fill='#fff7b0'/>
  <!-- little leaf -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='30' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#5aa832' transform='rotate(-20 56 30)'/>
</svg>
